purpose: STScI's own HST calibration software, to re-run an archive observation's instrument pipeline from its raw exposure: calstis (cs0.e) for STIS, calwf3.e for WFC3, calacs.e for ACS, with CRDS reference files at a pinned context.
license: hstcal, stistools, wfc3tools, acstools, drizzlepac, crds: BSD-3-Clause (STScI)
platform: osx-arm64; hstcal 3.2.0 has a conda-forge osx-arm64 build and drizzlepac 3.11.0 a cp312 macosx_11_0_arm64 wheel, so no x86_64 emulation is needed.
memory: One STIS/FUV-MAMA G140L ACCUM exposure (2048 x 2048, 16 MB raw) calibrates at under 0.2 GiB; one STIS/CCD 1060 x 80 subarray at under 0.15 GiB. Both are far below the 2 GiB ceiling calibrate.mts uses by default.
